_comment: The files Invoice Studio shares with Advanced Charts, copied verbatim into src/core/ by
scripts/sync-core.mjs. Paths are relative to the SOURCE repo. A file listed here is read-only
in this repository: fix it upstream, then re-sync, or the next --check will fail the build.
Adding to this list is cheap. Editing a synced file in place is what costs a week six months
from now, when the same bug gets fixed twice in two different ways.
